_meta.title: NBA playing rules that the models actually depend on
_meta.why: Each model assumption is traced to the specific rule text that fixes it, so a reviewer can check the input rather than trust it.
_meta.note: Only rules that change a number in this project are listed. The rulebook contains many more.

rules.name: Five players per team on the floor
rules.cited_text_summary: Each team shall have five players on the floor during play.

rules.name: Sixth personal foul disqualifies
rules.cited_text_summary: A player is disqualified on his sixth personal foul.

rules.name: Lineups submitted 30 minutes before tip-off
rules.cited_text_summary: Starting lineups must be submitted to the scorer at least 30 minutes before the game.

rules.name: Twelve-minute quarters
rules.cited_text_summary: The game consists of four 12-minute periods.

rules.name: Five-minute overtime
rules.cited_text_summary: Each overtime period is five minutes.
rules.unit: minutes per extra period per player
used_in: total dispersion (OT games excluded from the sd)

rules.name: Fifteen-minute halftime
used_in: game flow commentary only — not modelled

rules.name: Timeout allotment
rules.cited_text_summary: Seven timeouts per regulation game, no more than four in the fourth quarter, two in overtime.
used_in: game flow commentary only — not modelled

rules.name: 24-second shot clock
rules.cited_text_summary: The shot clock starts at 24 seconds and displays tenths below 4.9 seconds.

rules.name: Legal field-goal attempt requires rim contact
rules.cited_text_summary: The ball must leave the shooter's hand before expiry AND make contact with the basket ring after leaving the hand.

rules.name: 14-second reset
rules.cited_text_summary: The shot clock resets to 14 seconds on an offensive rebound or on certain frontcourt restarts, and never resets in several listed situations.

rules.name: Injury report deadlines
rules.cited_text_summary: Reports are due by 5:00 PM local the day before a game and by 1:00 PM for the second of a back-to-back; game-day updates run 11:00 AM to 1:00 PM local, refreshed every 15 minutes.
